job.job_description:
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer with strong expertise in Agentic AI, AI Deployment, and AI Implementation to build and deploy enterprise-grade GenAI solutions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in developing AI agents, implementing RAG solutions, integrating LLMs, and deploying AI applications in production environments.




Location: PAN India (Hybrid)
Experience: 5-10 Years

Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days




Job Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI and GenAI solutions.
Build AI agents, RAG applications, and enterprise copilots.
Deploy and manage AI solutions in production environments.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications and workflows.

Requirements:

5+ years of AI/ML experience.
Hands-on experience with Agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, etc.).
Strong experience in AI deployment and implementation.
Proficiency in Python and cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
Must be available to join within 30 days.
